definitions.gloss: foot of a mountain, base, bottom
definitions.explanation: The lowest part of a mountain or hill where it meets the plain.

examples.english: There's a small village at the foot of the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麓|ふもと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We camped at the base of Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: {麓|ふもと}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧3⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes 3 hours from the base to the summit.

notes:
{麓|ふもと} refers specifically to the bottom or base of mountains and hills.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{麓|ふもと} (foot of the mountain)
- {麓|ふもと}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧ (to climb from the base)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {麓|ふもと} (foot of mountain - bottom)
- ⟦{山頂|さんちょう}→山頂：09942_sanchou⟧ / ⟦{頂上|ちょうじょう}→頂上：03493_choujou⟧ (summit - top)
- ⟦{中腹|ちゅうふく}→中腹：19031_chuufuku⟧ (halfway up the mountain)

NOTE: The kanji {麓|ふもと} is relatively complex (⟦{麻|あさ}→麻：noentry⟧ + ⟦{鹿|しか}→鹿：04347_shika⟧). It is sometimes written in hiragana.
